# Mango Stack AI

Mango Stack AI builds custom software, AI systems, workflow automation, and digital marketing systems for growing teams and enterprise operations.

## Services

- Custom Software Solutions: full-stack web and mobile applications, microservices, API design, cloud deployments, DevOps, and CI/CD.
- Advanced Automation: business process automation, workflow orchestration, data pipelines, cross-platform integrations, reporting, and compliance workflows.
- Artificial Intelligence Systems: LLM features, RAG pipelines, computer vision, NLP systems, predictive analytics, AI agents, and MLOps.
- Digital Marketing Services: technical SEO, paid media, content strategy, marketing automation, analytics, attribution, and conversion optimization.
